{{Quote|The two towns on Rori, Narmle and Restuss, stage frequent debates between their intellectuals. Victory validates the winner's superiority. It's Rori's equivalent of a sporting match.|[[Sindra Lintikoor]]|<ref name="SWG:SL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Sindra Lintikoor|Rori}}</ref>}}
